# vappcloud_compute_instance (Data Source)

Reads a cloud compute instance by opaque public ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vappcloud_compute_instance" "selected" {
  id = "compute_example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `cloud_connection_id` (String) Cloud connection ID.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `default_vmm_id` (String) Default VMM ID.
- `device_id` (String) Attached device ID.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `image` (String) Cloud image.
- `name` (String) Compute instance name.
- `project_id` (String) Owning project ID.
- `region` (String) Cloud region.
- `resource_version` (Number) Optimistic concurrency version.
- `size` (String) Cloud size.
- `state` (String) Provisioning and readiness state.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
